notes.title: Cyber-Doge 2077 Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]Hello friends![/h3]
[h3]We have a new game coming out soon - Cyber-Doge 2077: Meme runner.[/h3]
[previewyoutube=wyzZi_0rXMk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]About the game[/h1]
Furious 3D runner about a pumped up dog. Run as far as possible! Collect coins! Set new records and enjoy a great soundtrack.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1383720/Cyberdoge_2077_Meme_runner/

[h2]If you like the game, please [u]add it to your Steam Wishlist.[/u][/h2]

Best regards,
Take Toad.

notes.title: macOS and Linux
notes.content: Now the game is available for macOS and Linux!

notes.title: Balance update and bug fix
notes.content: Having studied your reviews, I decided to slightly adjust the balance in the game and made the enemies a little more tenacious with each wave. I also fixed a bug with displaying coins. I fixed the error when the wave did not reset when going to the main menu.
